# BMNova

> BMNova (BMNova Innovations) is an independent mobile app studio and consumer-app startup at Ostim Teknokent, Ankara, Turkey. It designs, builds and ships its own AI-powered apps for iOS and Android. It does not take client work.

Website: https://bmnova.com
Turkish site: https://bmnova.com/tr
About: https://bmnova.com/about-us
Contact: contact@bmnova.com
Blog: https://bmnova.com/blog

## What BMNova is

- Mobile app studio: in-house design, Flutter, a shared AI layer, and growth for its own consumer apps.
- Startup: a product company founded by Ali Mertcan Karaman, shipping from Ankara to a worldwide audience.
- Not an agency. Partners and investors: contact@bmnova.com.

## Apps

- [Pali](https://bmnova.com/projects/pali): GLP-1 companion (formerly DietPal). Shots and injection sites, side-effect check-ins, protein, water and weight, weekly review.
- [FitVibe](https://bmnova.com/projects/fitvibe): AI digital wardrobe and stylist. Background removal, outfit combinations, wardrobe gaps, virtual try-on.
- [Haki](https://bmnova.com/projects/haki): AI manga, manhwa and comics maker with consistent characters and editable multi-panel pages.
- [RoomPace](https://bmnova.com/projects/roompace): Budget-aware AI interior design with a shoppable furniture wishlist.
- [NextStep](https://bmnova.com/projects/nextstep): Minimalist AI coaching for overthinking. One reflection, one question, one clear next step.
- [Bloomish](https://bmnova.com/projects/bloomish): AI bouquet generator for sending digital flower gifts.
- [Offer](https://bmnova.com/projects/offer): Social icebreaker. Offer drinks or snacks at local businesses to meet people nearby.

Turkish versions of every page live under https://bmnova.com/tr, with Turkish blog posts at https://bmnova.com/tr/blog.

## Also by BMNova

- [intyx.ai](https://intyx.ai): CSV to AI dashboards — upload data, get interactive charts in seconds.
- [dynamic.intyx.ai](https://dynamic.intyx.ai): Real-time Flutter content updates without shipping a new app build.
